headline: JTEKT Column Systems Corporation discloses substantial acquisition under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: JTEKT Column Systems Corporation has filed a disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in JTEKT India Limited, a subsidiary engaged in automotive precision engineering.
detail: The disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4), was submitted to NSE on 30 June 2026. This regulation requires disclosure of specified shareholding milestones (typically 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, etc.). The filing does not specify the acquisition amount, date of acquisition, or percentage acquired in the excerpt provided; full particulars are contained in the original disclosure document filed with the exchange.
